summary.text: Charlotte Esau is a Republican state representative from Olathe who represents District 14 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
She served in the House from 2019 to 2023 and returned to the seat in January 2025; she is a genealogist by profession.

paragraphs.text: Charlotte Esau was born and lives in Olathe, Kansas, and her professional experience includes working as a genealogist.
She volunteers with the Olathe Public Library and serves as a volunteer counselor with La Leche League.
Esau first served in the Kansas House of Representatives District 14 seat from 2019 to 2023, and assumed office again on January 13, 2025.

For 2025 and 2026 she is assigned to the Child Welfare and Foster Care, House Judiciary, Legislative Modernization (vice chair) and Welfare Reform committees, and the Child Welfare System Oversight Committee.
